recreation_brief:
1. Page setup: set the slide background to white (#FFFFFF) and draw a thin red (#C00000) border line around the entire page edge.
2. Content frame: draw a large rectangle with a red/maroon (#C00000) outline and white fill, spanning roughly x 7-93%, y 23-97% of the slide.
3. Title box: draw a pale-yellow (#FFFFCC) rectangle with a thin purple (#7030A0) outline at roughly x 10-34%, y 15-27%, overlapping the frame's top edge; place bold black sans-serif text 'Pre processing' inside it — the largest text on the slide.
4. Slide-number badge: draw a yellow (#FFFF99) circle with a purple (#7030A0) outline at roughly x 88-93%, y 10-16% (top-right, above the frame); place '31' in dark (black) text inside.
5. Header line: inside the frame, left-aligned at roughly x 12%, y ~30%, place the single line 'Preprocessing is Problem dependent and data dependent', rendering 'Preprocessing is' in bold red (#FF0000) and 'Problem dependent and data dependent' in bold italic underlined black — second-largest text.
6. Lead-in: directly below the header line, place 'It may include:' in bold black — third-largest text.
7. Plain line: below the lead-in, place 'Gap filling' in regular-weight black with no bullet marker.
8. Bulleted list: below 'Gap filling', place 9 round-bulleted entries in regular-weight black, one per line, in this order: 'Thinning', 'Contour', 'Binarization', 'Noise Removal', 'Color to Gray', 'Opening touched points', 'Resizing', 'Normalization', '......' (final ellipsis entry). Steps 6-8 together occupy roughly x 12-35%, y 38-95%.
9. Typography: use one sans-serif family (e.g., Arial) throughout; all body text left-aligned black; keep the size hierarchy: title > header line > 'It may include:' > list items.
